01-goals-and-scope.md
Goals, scope and domain language
GOAL
Walkthrough covers legitimate heavy returns, defective buyers, benign sharing, deceptive claims, coordination, temporary use and mixed cases without revealing truth on cases.
No UI/API can suspend accounts, refund orders, generate LLM verdicts or route inspections.
Review budget is 5% of eligible customers; excluded-history counts and fallback are visible.
Synthetic and prototype data are clearly labelled; mock values are not evaluated results.

Walkthrough explains, with one case each and no truth on case pages, four reasons the return-rate rule misranks: honest heavy returns, abuse inside an ordinary return rate, thin history and linked accounts.
02-synthetic-data-generation.md
Synthetic data generation
GEN
Pinned seed/config/lock reproduces canonical sorted tables; different seeds vary; CSV/Parquet values match.
Adapter preserves 300 SKUs/37 styles, prices/windows/variants/launch dates and source hash.

Abuse-off preserves base sales and honest request content and removes every campaign order (return header identifiers and line numbers may differ); quantity-three fixture with one honest/one abusive request yields two requested units.
Five sale states and all cutoff chronology pass; future plans do not enter snapshot.
Population-average probabilities equal .04/.03/.005; invalid allocation fails; no forced realized quotas.

Labels reconstruct from action/request/unit joins; nonacting group members and planned-only targets are not positive; a style is targeted iff one group has >=3 accounts with completed coordinated claims.
Assigned sharing and realized links differ legitimately; one-order usage may be 0%/100%.
Coverage, eligibility, excluded abuse, segment support and blocked-campaign reports precede full generation.
Campaign orders obey signup/launch/cutoff chronology and are marked only in private order_truth; coordinated claims occur only on world hot-list styles; uncompleted attempts keep a reason.

Per-account action rates and per-address genuine-failure multipliers reproduce from keyed streams; realized means versus .20 and the configured claim rates are reported; the temporary-use occasion weighting matches a fixture; claim timing, basket shape, header line order and same-day orders do not separate honest from abusive requests.

Reports identify disjoint feature support and genuine/deceptive code overlap.

06-feature-engineering.md
Feature engineering and explanatory evidence
FEAT
Hand-calculated partial quantity, two-level shrinkage, sole buyer, single-SKU style/no peers and V=0 fixtures match.
Ordered 17-feature schema enforced, with the two link measures kept out of the model matrix; identity renaming preserving equality leaves features unchanged.
Eligibility threshold exactly three mature lines; recent requests affect composition but not mature rate.
One shared type no edge; two edge; fanout26 value removed; empty vs failed graph distinguished.
All six style states and signal boundaries correct; claims 7 days apart link and 8 do not; different SKUs of one style link; unsupported neighbors never link; low-link misses reported.

Wardrobing integer boundaries 35/75, one late return without occasion wear or a half share (25 points, no band), the 75%/100% window boundaries, a request after the window, a claim that is not an item return, and no-return fixtures match without mixing into model risk.
Changing private labels with operational inputs fixed, or removing private truth altogether, changes no features or predictions.
coordinated_claim_share matches the style-grain linked-claim rule on a hand-built fixture and counts each own line once.

08-model-evaluation.md
Model and evidence evaluation
EVAL
Hand-labelled ceil/tie/pooled fixtures give correct precision/recall/FPR at1/5/10%.
Segment<200 fails validation coverage; zero denominator never becomes0% FPR.
Quantile ties/kept defective unit/unused household identifier/overlap fixtures have correct segment membership.
Reports include paired whole-world intervals and per-world results without significance claims.
Style/wardrobing misses, no-return state, coverage and null metrics are present.

Rulebook and volume-only references use the identical population/k/ties and training-only thresholds, are flagged report-only and cannot be selected.
Error account gives false-positive and false-negative splits with denominators plus model-versus-baseline selection differences; the calibration disclosure is present.
09-model-selection.md
Model selection and promotion gate
SEL
Higher precision/worse household FPR fails; equal precision fails.
Passing ties follow worst FPR then ordinal.
No winner produces fallback without fabricated promotion.
Selection record precedes test; test failure prevents runner-up switching.
Test-informed iteration retains failure and uses untouched test worlds.
Dated gate dry run on out-of-fold training scores precedes validation manifests and selects nothing; gate rule and segment definitions are unchanged afterwards.
